source: Création d'une interface de lobby stylisée 'Battle Royale' (type Fortnite).\n​Ajoute une pop-up d'avertissement non bloquante au démarrage qui s'affiche proprement et disparaît après validation, rappelant de configurer l'avatar en R15.\n​Ajoute un bouton de menu simple permettant de basculer l'ambiance visuelle entre un mode 'Classique' et un mode 'Rendu épuré' pour la map, sans surcharger la console d'erreurs.

answers.ask: Is the lobby the whole game, or does it feed into a battle royale match map we should build too?
answers.answer: Le périmètre demandé est uniquement le lobby et son interface stylisée ; ne construisez pas de map de match Battle Royale pour cette première version.

answers.ask: How many players should the lobby hold at once?
answers.answer: Prévoyez un petit lobby pouvant accueillir jusqu’à 10 joueurs simultanément.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] genre — Q: Is the lobby the whole game, or does it feed into a battle royale match map we should build too? A: Le périmètre demandé est uniquement le lobby et son interface stylisée ; ne construisez pas de map de match Battle Royale pour cette première version.
- [author] scale — Q: How many players should the lobby hold at once? A: Prévoyez un petit lobby pouvant accueillir jusqu’à 10 joueurs simultanément.
- [agent_inferred] boundary — Q: Is the small lobby an enclosed room or an outdoor plaza? A: Use one compact enclosed lobby room, the narrowest interpretation of a lobby-only first version.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a small, enclosed 3D lobby for up to 10 simultaneous players, presented in a bright, stylized battle-royale visual register. Arrange one clear arrival edge facing a compact central gathering area, with enough open floor and circulation space for all 10 avatars without adding a match map. Keep the environment visually clean and uncluttered so either a classic or simplified rendering treatment can be applied later; the interface pop-up, menu button, and avatar-configuration reminder are not physical parts of the map.

## Genre
The result is No Genre. The author explicitly limits this version to a social lobby and interface, with no battle-royale match activity or other genre-owned gameplay space.

## Shape and preset
No canonical shape applies under No Genre. On the routing axes, enclosure is `interior-only`; verticality is `single-surface`; zone-count is `single`; structure is `dressed`; and play-space is `grounded-surface`. The matched preset is Social Space, reduced to the gathering and arrival features actually supported by the request.

## Config requirements
Use `social-hub` for the compact central floor where the 10 players can gather. Use the visible half of `spawn-area` for a deliberately composed arrival edge facing that gathering floor. Do not add a battle arena, match portal, or unsupported decorative landmark.

## Layout requirements
Place one `spawn-area` arrival cluster along the near edge of the room with 10 non-overlapping player spawn positions, all oriented toward the central gathering area. The warning pop-up, validation behavior, visual-mode menu, and R15 reminder are UI or scripting requirements and require no layout placement.

## Layout components
The build is one compact enclosed lobby room. Its central zone is an open gathering floor sized for 10 avatars; a shallow arrival strip sits in the foreground and opens directly into it. Simple circulation runs around the gathering floor without separate rooms, upper levels, or exterior transitions. Solid lobby walls form the boundary. Frame the isometric view so the arrival edge, all 10 standing positions, and the central social space are legible at once.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: render the stylized lobby from text first and derive the top-down plan from it. The isometric image is authoritative because appearance and clean presentation lead, while the topology is a simple single room.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is small, driven by a compact room whose smallest required details are 10 individual avatar positions. The theme is bright, polished, stylized battle-royale lobby design without copying a named franchise. `P0` is sufficient: this is one interior-only, single-surface space with no separate maps, outside-to-inside transition, overhang, or structure-critical route.
